SELECT b.BOARD_NO AS boardNo, b.WRITER_ID AS writerId, b.BOARD_TITLE AS boardTitle, b.BOARD_CONTENT AS boardContent, b.BOARD_THUMB AS boardThumb, DATE_FORMAT(b.BOARD_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS boardDate, b.MEMBER_NICKNAME AS memberNickname, m.MEMBER_THUMB AS memberThumb, b.BOARD_STATUS AS boardStatus, b.BOARD_LAT AS boardLat, b.BOARD_LNG AS boardLng, b.READ_COUNT AS readCount, b.ADDR AS addr, IFNULL((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM board_like_tbl l WHERE l.BOARD_NO = b.BOARD_NO), 0) AS likeCount,
b.MEMBER_NICKNAME AS writerNickname, DATE_FORMAT(b.BOARD_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS createDate, DATE_FORMAT(b.UPDATED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS updatedAt, b.BOARD_THUMB AS thumbnailUrl, 0 AS commentCount FROM board_tbl b LEFT JOIN member_tbl1 m ON b.WRITER_ID = m.MEMBER_ID WHERE BOARD_STATUS = #{status} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM store_board_tbl s WHERE s.BOARD_NO = b.BOARD_NO )
AND b.ctpv = #{sido}
AND b.sgg = #{sigungu}
AND BOARD_TITLE LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%')
AND MEMBER_NICKNAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%')

ORDER BY b.BOARD_DATE DESC, b.BOARD_NO DESC

mapper.select: select b.board_no, b.board_title, b.board_content, m.member_thumb, b.member_nickname, b.board_status, b.board_lat, b.board_lng, b.ctpv, b.sgg, b.addr, c.ctpvsgg_id, c.sgg_nm, COUNT(b.board_no) AS board_count, count(l.board_no) as like_count from board_tbl b left join member_tbl1 m on (b.member_nickname = m.member_nickname) left join ctpvsgg_tbl c on (b.ctpv = c.ctpv_nm AND c.sgg_nm = b.sgg) left join board_tbl b2 on (b.ctpv = b2.ctpv and b.sgg = b2.sgg) left join board_like_tbl l on (b.board_no = l.board_no) where b.board_status = 0 and b.addr is not null or b.board_no = b2.board_no or l.board_no = l.board_no group by b.board_no, b.board_title, b.board_content, m.member_thumb, b.member_nickname, b.board_status, b.board_lat, b.board_lng, b.ctpv, b.sgg, b.addr, c.ctpvsgg_id, c.sgg_nm, l.board_no order by b.board_lat desc

SELECT ctpv, sgg, SUM(board_count) AS board_count FROM ( SELECT b.ctpv AS ctpv, b.sgg AS sgg, COUNT(b.board_no) AS board_count FROM board_tbl b GROUP BY b.ctpv, b.sgg UNION ALL SELECT r.ctpv_nm AS ctpv, r.sgg_nm AS sgg, COUNT(s.market_no) AS board_count FROM store_board_tbl s JOIN ctpvsgg_tbl r ON s.ctpvsgg_id = r.ctpvsgg_id WHERE s.is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY r.ctpv_nm, r.sgg_nm ) AS total_summary GROUP BY ctpv, sgg

SELECT b.BOARD_NO AS boardNo, b.WRITER_ID AS writerId, b.BOARD_TITLE AS boardTitle, b.BOARD_CONTENT AS boardContent, b.BOARD_THUMB AS boardThumb, DATE_FORMAT(b.BOARD_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS boardDate, b.MEMBER_NICKNAME AS memberNickname, b.BOARD_STATUS AS boardStatus, b.BOARD_LAT AS boardLat, b.BOARD_LNG AS boardLng, b.READ_COUNT AS readCount, IFNULL((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM board_like_tbl l WHERE l.BOARD_NO = b.BOARD_NO), 0) AS likeCount, b.MEMBER_NICKNAME AS writerNickname, DATE_FORMAT(b.BOARD_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS createDate, DATE_FORMAT(b.UPDATED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS updatedAt, b.BOARD_THUMB AS thumbnailUrl, (select count(*) from board_comment_tbl c where c.board_no = b.board_no) as commentCount FROM board_tbl b WHERE b.board_no = #{boardNo} AND b.board_status = 0

select r.report_no, r.target_no, r.target_type, r.report_category, r.report_content, r.report_date, r.report_status, (select count(*) from report_tbl where target_no = r.target_no and target_type = r.target_type) as reportCount, case when r.target_type = 'board' then b.writer_id when r.target_type = 'comment' then c.board_comment_writer end as targetId, case when r.target_type = 'board' then r.target_no when r.target_type = 'comment' then c.board_no end as boardNo from report_tbl r left join board_tbl b on r.target_no = b.board_no and r.target_type = 'board' left join board_comment_tbl c on r.target_no = c.board_comment_no and r.target_type = 'comment' where target_no = #{targetNo} and target_type = #{targetType} and report_no != #{reportNo}
